title: AI Robotics Race
summary: Major tech companies and startups are competing to build humanoid robots using AI, with Boston Dynamics, Tesla Optimus, and Chinese manufacturers all racing to achieve commercial deployment.

title: Dangerous AI Models
summary: Concerns are growing that powerful AI models are being deployed without adequate safety measures, with critics warning of potential misuse, misinformation, and risks to job markets.

title: AI Models and Assistants
summary: New AI assistants and language models are rapidly advancing in capability, with companies like Anthropic and OpenAI releasing systems that handle increasingly complex tasks across industries.
